title: Post-treatment periodontal care plan — Timothy Jones

detail.description: Daily oral hygiene: brushing technique and flossing as instructed; age-appropriate toothpaste
Six-month periodontal recall to reassess and monitor the partially erupted lower central incisor
Coordinate periodontal management with the diabetes care team (glycemic control affects periodontal outcomes and vice versa)

note.text: Post-treatment care plan surfaced to Timothy's guardian-facing app alongside the visit-complete milestone at Interaction 4. Recall interval and oral-hygiene reinforcement reflect the elevated periodontal risk from Type 1 diabetes.
